planets.name: TOI-2257 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2257 with a 35.2-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-2257 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2257. Its orbit and size follow Schanche et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname SCHANCHE_ET_AL__2022): disc_year 2021, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 35.189346, pl_radj 0.19573591, pl_bmassj 0.0171

quotes.title: TOI-2257 b
quotes.card: TOI-2257 b is an extremely eccentric (0.496) exoplanet in or near the circumstellar habitable zone of the star TOI-2257, 188 light-years away.
quotes.introduction: It is likely a sub-Neptune exoplanet, with a mass of 5.71 M🜨 and a radius of 2.19 R🜨.
